# serverroom_server (Data Source)

One dedicated server: its machine, operating system, location, port speed, features and addresses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "serverroom_server" "web" {
  account_id = 246447
}

output "web_ip" {
  value = data.serverroom_server.web.ipv4[0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (Number) The service's account id.

### Read-Only

- `features` (Map of String)
- `ipv4` (List of String)
- `location` (String)
- `os` (String)
- `port_speed_mbps` (Number)
- `server_id` (Number)
